name: Pooled
description: Run a model across your own devices: this machine joins a Pooled room and holds part of the model on its GPU.

providerAuthChoices.choiceLabel: Pooled (run a model across your devices)
providerAuthChoices.choiceHint: Start a room on this device or join one; your Macs, PCs and phones share the model
providerAuthChoices.groupHint: Your own devices, no API key

mode.label: Role
mode.help: host: this machine starts the room. join: it joins another device's room and sends OpenClaw's whole conversation to that room's host, which also chooses the tool calls OpenClaw runs. Join only rooms you trust.

code.label: Room code
code.help: 6 characters, like 4TKG9P (shown as 4TK-G9P). With 'Anyone with the room code', anyone who has the code can join.

model.label: Model
model.help: host: qwen3.6-35b-moe (recommended for OpenClaw), qwen3.8-27b, or qwen3-1.7b (small: slow turns and tool loops)

waitSeconds.label: Wait for the room (s)
waitSeconds.help: how long a question waits for devices or the host's model

ask.label: Ask before new devices join
ask.help: on: a device with only the code waits for /pooled allow; the invite link gets in at once

allowApiClients.label: Answer other devices' API requests
allowApiClients.help: host: another OpenClaw in join mode or `pooled serve` may ask this room; off keeps this GPU for this OpenClaw

pull.label: Download the model
pull.help: into ~/.pooled/models (shared with pooled pull); off streams it at each start

prewarm.label: Warm up at start
prewarm.help: prefill the last system prompt and tools when the room comes online

name.label: Device name
name.help: this device's name in the room
